article.story: CINCINNATI -- — Tylen Riley scored 24 points off the bench and led a second-half charge, leading Cincinnati to a 78-68 victory over UMass Lowell on Sunday. After Cincinnati led by five points at halftime, Riley’s personal 8-0 run gave the Bearcats a 49-35 lead early in the second half and they led by double digits for the remainder. Riley scored 14 points after halftime, making 5 of 6 shots and going 4-for-4 at the free-throw line. MJ Collins scored 15 points and Tyler Tejada 10 for Cincinnati (5-1). Victor Okojie led the River Hawks (4-2) with 14 points and nine rebounds. Jakai Newton scored 13 points and Christian Jones and Jasiah Cannady scored 12 each. There were four ties and four lead changes in the first 12 minutes of the first half before Cincinnati eased ahead. The Bearcats led for the final eight minutes of the half although the 35-30 halftime score matched their biggest lead of the half. The Bearcats began to pull away early in the second half, scoring the first six points to go up 41-30 prior to Riley's 8-0 run. Up next Cincinnati: The Bearcats play Georgia on Thursday in the ESPN Events Invitational in Orlando, Fla. UMass Lowell: The River Hawks take on Hampton on Friday in the Capital Thanksgiving Classic in Washington. -------- Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here.
